basic_details.job_title: NBT Senior Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust, India (NBT), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is filling 01 Senior Executive Assistant post purely on contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for 01 year and extendable as per the requirement of the Trust, at a monthly remuneration of Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/-. Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) from a recognized university, two years of working experience and must be 18-35 years old. important_dates.last_date_to_apply: About 5 December 2026 (10 days from publication on the NBT website)

how_to_apply: Interested candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply online through the website www.nbtindia.gov.in. The last date for receipt of applications is 10 days from the date of publishing of the advertisement on the NBT website, which works out to about 5 December 2026 when counted from the advertisement date of 25 November 2026. The notice does not list documents to upload or describe the steps of the online form.
important_instructions: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the posts as advertised, if circumstances so warrant. The engagement is through a manpower agency, not a direct appointment by the Trust. Only candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria should apply.

content_sections.heading: About NBT
content_sections.text: National Book Trust, India describes itself in the notice as an apex body in the publication of books and book promotion in the country. It works under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, and its office is at 5 Institutional Area, Phase-2, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070 (phone: 91-11-35464620).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy notice sets three requirements for the Senior Executive Assistant post: an educational qualification, technical skills and work experience. Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) from a recognized university. Technical Skills: Must have proficient, hands-on computer skills, specifically in MS Office (MS Word, Excel, and Powerpoint). Work Experience: Must have a minimum of two (02) years of working experience along with good knowledge of official noting and drafting as per government rules. Age Limit: 18-35 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age, and it does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the Senior Executive Assistant post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Senior Executive Assistant post carries a monthly remuneration of Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/-. The notice does not say how the exact amount within this range will be fixed, and it mentions no allowances. The engagement is purely on contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for 01 year, and is extendable as per the requirement of the Trust.
